title: Nice bowls
text: Nice bowls. Two stars because it took over 6 weeks to get here !! But 5 plus stars for how beautiful and well made they are !

product_metadata.title: Pfaltzgraff Trellis, Serve Bowl, 9", White
features: GARDEN INSPIRED: a subtle scroll pattern and dark striations give this bowl the appearance of being weathered by the elements
MULTIPLE USES: ideal for serving vegetables, rolls, salads, pastas, and sides
BEAUTIFULLY CRAFTED: made of high-quality stoneware perfect for everyday dining or formal occasions
OPTIMAL SIZE: bowl holds a generous quantity of food and has a 9-inch diameter
EASY CLEANING & REHEATING: dishwasher safe for fast, simple cleanup, and microwave safe for quick reheating
description: Inspired by the rustic framework of classic summer garden designs, this Trellis Serving Bowl features a subtle scroll pattern and dark striations that give it the appearance of being weathered by the elements. The eye-catching, vintage look makes a bold statement on a contemporary tabletop. Made of high-quality stoneware. Measures 9 inches in diameter. Microwave and dishwasher safe.
